name: Hon Tam Resort
tagline: Relaxation for the body, mind, and soul
description: Hon Tam Resort Nha Trang, with its stunning natural beauty and luxurious bungalow and villa architecture, offers guests a top-notch resort experience. The resort is surrounded by lush natural scenery, providing the perfect ambiance for a tranquil, revitalizing stay.

contact.address: Hon Tam Island, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, Vietnam

room_types.name: Bungalow Deluxe Twin Garden
room_types.description: The bungalow measures 56m2 with a garden area of 74m2 and overlooks greenery, sporting an open design and giving visitors a feeling of peace and harmony with nature. The living space is boldly rustic with a focus on dark tones, effectively combining luxury and coziness.

room_types.name: Bungalow Deluxe Double Garden
room_types.description: Measuring 43m2, our Deluxe Double garden view rooms bring visitors a feeling of harmony with nature thanks to their open design overlooking our green garden. The room is suitable for couples, young families, or young couples who want to enjoy a private vacation at a reasonable price.

room_types.name: Forestal Deluxe Room
room_types.description: Enjoy a relaxing vacation with your friends in a room with 2 separate beds and a spacious open design overlooking a green garden. Guests staying in Forest Deluxe rooms are welcome to use the amenities of a 3 or 4-bedroom villa such as the swimming pool, common living area, etc….

room_types.name: Executive Suite Room
room_types.description: Enjoy a luxurious and comfortable stay in an Executive Suite in a 3 or 4-bedroom villa, with its spacious bedroom expanded to add a living room for our guests’ maximum comfort and convenience. Our executive suites are best suited for visitors such as young couples or businessmen who combine their work and vacation. Guests staying in Executive Suites are welcome to use the amenities of a 3 or 4-bedroom villa, such as the swimming pool, common living area, etc.…

room_types.name: Family Bungalow
room_types.description: With an area of 40m², this room type includes 1 bedroom with 2 double beds and 1 private bathroom, offering a convenient and comfortable resort space for the whole family. The cozy design, close to nature, allows parents and children to enjoy complete family moments while still feeling as relaxed as if they were in their own home.

room_types.name: Deluxe Family Bungalow
room_types.description: With a spacious area of 65m² and a lush garden, the Family Bungalow offers a private and comfortable retreat for the whole family amidst lush greenery. The room is designed with 2 bedrooms, featuring 1 double bed and 1 single bed, along with 2 bathrooms, perfect for parents and children to enjoy complete family moments in a cozy and convenient setting. Fully equipped with all necessary amenities, the Family Bungalow provides a sense of relaxation and comfort, just like being at home.

room_types.name: Villa 3 Bedrooms
room_types.description: A 3-bedroom oceanfront villa seated on a hill with an area of 291m2 and a landscape space of 454 - 715m2. Sporting a modern, luxurious design with full amenities and a private swimming pool, the villa is suitable for all customers, from large families of explorers to energetic groups of young people, to businessmen who like to combine their work and vacation.

Hon Tam Resort Nha Trang, with its stunning natural beauty and luxurious bungalow and villa architecture, offers guests a top-notch resort experience. The resort is surrounded by lush natural scenery, providing the perfect ambiance for a tranquil, revitalizing stay.
